title.en: Any repeats, in how many comparisons?

hints.tr: `count_pairs` ile aynı iki döngü: `for i in range(len(items)):` ve `for j in range(i + 1, len(items)):`.
hints.en: The same two loops as `count_pairs`: `for i in range(len(items)):` and `for j in range(i + 1, len(items)):`.

hints.tr: İç döngüde önce `comparisons += 1`, sonra `if items[i] == items[j]: return True, comparisons`.
hints.en: In the inner loop first `comparisons += 1`, then `if items[i] == items[j]: return True, comparisons`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def has_duplicate(items):
    comparisons = 0
    for i in range(len(items)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(items)):
            comparisons += 1
            if items[i] == items[j]:
                return True, comparisons
    return False, comparisons


print(has_duplicate([4, 4, 1, 2]))
print(has_duplicate([1, 2, 3, 2]))
print(has_duplicate(list(range(100))))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def has_duplicate(items):
    comparisons = 0
    for i in range(len(items)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(items)):
            comparisons += 1
            if items[i] == items[j]:
                return True, comparisons
    return False, comparisons


print(has_duplicate([4, 4, 1, 2]))
print(has_duplicate([1, 2, 3, 2]))
print(has_duplicate(list(range(100))))
```
